item.description:
Víkingur Ólafsson, piano
Beethoven · Bach · Schubert - Opus 109
Recorded at the Norðurljós Hall, Harpa Concert House, Reykjavík in VII.2025

Cover + Booklet
Published: 2025
File Size: 2.54 Gb
FLAC 24-bit/192kHz

TRACKLIST:
Bach - The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book I
01. Prelude No. 9 in E Major, BWV 854 (1:44)
Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 27 in E Minor, Op. 90
02. I. Mit Lebhaftigkeit und durchaus mit Empfindung und Ausdruck (5:44)
03. II. Nicht zu geschwind und sehr singbar vorgetragen (7:17)
Bach - Partita No. 6 in E Minor, BWV 830
04. I. Toccata (8:07)

06. III. Corrente (4:06)
07. IV. Air (1:17)
08. V. Sarabande (7:42)
09. VI. Tempo di Gavotta (1:56)
10. VII. Gigue (2:34)
Schubert - Piano Sonata No. 6 in E Minor, D. 566

Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 30 in E Major, Op. 109
13. I. Vivace ma non troppo – Adagio espressivo (4:00)
14. II. Prestissimo (2:24)
15. III. Andante molto cantabile ed espressivo (12:49)
Bach - French Suite No. 6 in E Major, BWV 817
16. III. Sarabande (2:39)
Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 30 in E Major, Op. 109
17. III. Andante molto cantabile ed espressivo (Edit) (2:21)

Critics and listeners are delighted with how the pianist reveals historical and musical connections between eras. He shows how the influence of Bach can be heard in Beethoven's later compositions, and Schubert's sonata echoes Beethoven's.
All the pieces in the album are written in the key of E (major and minor).

Digital Release Deutsche Grammophon
